summary.text: Rickie Gonzales II is the Democratic candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where incumbent Tanya Mirabal Moya (R) is also on the ballot.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary.
